title: The router joins the drawing
body: gw-1 was always there and the diagram was quietly pretending otherwise — air-1 appeared to reach the switch directly. It now shows the real path: Wi-Fi to the router, a wired uplink to the switch, and the minis behind that. Addressing moved to DHCP reservations on gw-1 so a reinstalled mini comes back where it was.

title: The lab gets a status page
body: First published inventory: mini-1 provisioned and reachable, mini-2 through mini-4 racked but not yet installed, sw-1 wiring them together. The topology diagram and this log start here, so the first entry has nothing to diff against.
